'''Victor Vasil'evich Borisov''' ({{langx|ru|Виктор Васильевич Борисов}}) (31 October 1937 – 5 December 2013) was a Russian 
[[physicist]] and [[mathematician]] who contributed to the theory of wave motion, 
in particular to [[time domain electromagnetics]] and [[localized wave]]s.

Under his guidance, [[Vladimir Smirnov (mathematician)|Vladimir Smirnov]]'s approach to solving the initial-boundary value problem to the [[hyperbolic partial differential equation]]s (in particular, the [[wave equation]])<ref name=Smi1937>V.I. Smirnov, The solution to a problem with limits for the equation of waves in the case of the circle and the sphere. ''Dokl. Akad. Nauk SSSR [Comptes Rendus de l’Académie des Sciences de l'URSS]'', '''14'''(1), 13–16 (1937).</ref> was developed into the [[spacetime triangle diagram technique|spacetime triangle diagram (STTD) technique]].

Victor Borisov's findings and ideas are summarized in two monographs edited by Leningrad State University.<ref name=Bor1987>V.V. Borisov, ''Nonsteady-State Electromagnetic Waves''. Leningrad: Leningrad State University Press (1987, in Russian).</ref><ref name=Bor1991>V.V. Borisov, ''Nonsteady-State Fields in Waveguides''. Leningrad: Leningrad State University Press (1991, in Russian).</ref>

== Particular discoveries ==
* 1970s Description of the essentially non-sinusoidal fields emanated by perfectly conducting sources at motion.<ref name=BorSphere1975>
V.V. Borisov, 
[http://apps.webofknowledge.com/full_record.do?product=UA&search_mode=GeneralSearch&qid=1&SID=S22NdIn8oa7GhPn2alk&page=1&doc=1 Electromagnetic-field of a rotating completely-conducting ball.] 
''Zhurnal Tekhnicheskoi Fiziki'' '''45'''(11), 2257–2266 (1975), WOS:A1975AW87400001
</ref><ref name=BorCondPlate1976>
V.V. Borisov, 
[http://apps.webofknowledge.com/full_record.do?product=UA&search_mode=MarkedList&qid=3&SID=N2Jt1Ccty3KvmLGa4Ju&page=5&doc=44&colName=WOS Electromagnetic-field accompanying motion of an ideally conducting plate.] 
''Vestnik Leningradskogo Universiteta Seriya Fizika Khimiya'' '''2''', 71–74 (1976), WOS:A1976CB24300012.
</ref>

* 1980 Transformation of electromagnetic signals at abrupt variation of medium properties,<ref name=BorVarMedium1980>
V.V. Borisov,
[http://apps.webofknowledge.com/full_record.do?product=UA&search_mode=MarkedList&qid=3&SID=N2Jt1Ccty3KvmLGa4Ju&page=5&doc=42&colName=WOS Transformation of an electromagnetic signal in a sharp variation of medium properties with time.]
''Izvestiya Vysshikh Uchebnykh Zavedenii Radiofizika'' '''23'''(12), 1495–1506 (1980), WOS:A1980LH40800013.
</ref> including guiding systems.<ref name=BorVarMediumGS1980>
V.V. Borisov,
[http://apps.webofknowledge.com/full_record.do?product=UA&search_mode=MarkedList&qid=3&SID=N2Jt1Ccty3KvmLGa4Ju&page=5&doc=41&colName=WOS Electromagnetic-fields in a cylindrical wave-guide filled by an ionized-gas moving with a constant velocity.]
''Izvestiya Vysshikh Uchebnykh Zavedenii Radiofizika'' '''23'''(12), 1484–1494 (1980), WOS:A1980LH40800012.
</ref>

* 1993 Characterization of electromagnetic fields accompanying propagation of spike pulses of hard radiation in media.<ref name=BorUtk1993>
V.V. Borisov & A.B. Utkin, 
[http://stacks.iop.org/0305-4470/26/i=16/a=023?key=crossref.6259c0352fa9296b11f3c3dc4f4df5f9 Electromagnetic fields produced by the spike pulse of hard radiation.] 
''Journal of Physics A: Mathematical and General'' '''26'''(16), 4081–4085 (1993), doi:10.1088/0305-4470/26/16/023.
</ref>

* 1994 General modal solutions for subluminal and luminal sources distributed on a circle.<ref name=BorSim1994>
V.V. Borisov & I.I. Simonenko, 
[http://stacks.iop.org/0305-4470/27/i=18/a=032?key=crossref.b180bab1626bb7381b87af84bed53c2c Transient waves generated by a source on a circle.]
''Journal of Physics A: Mathematical and General'' '''27'''(18), 6243–6252 (1994), doi:10.1088/0305-4470/27/18/032.
</ref>

* 1994 Physically tenable models of generating finite-[[Support (mathematics)|support]], truncated [http://scitation.aip.org/content/aip/journal/jap/57/3/10.1063/1.334712 focus wave modes] in free space,<ref name=BorUtkForm1994>
V.V. Borisov & A.B. Utkin, 
[http://stacks.iop.org/0305-4470/27/i=7/a=033?key=crossref.54a36bcd403c57bc1c6ed0a4be2a798f On formation of focus wave modes.]
''Journal of Physics A: Mathematical and General'' '''27'''(7), 2587–2591 (1994), doi:10.1088/0305-4470/27/7/033
</ref> noncollisional plasma,<ref name=BorUtkPlasma1994>
V.V. Borisov & A.B. Utkin, 
[http://www.nrcresearchpress.com/doi/abs/10.1139/p94-083 Focus wave modes in noncollisional plasma.]
''Canadian Journal of Physics'' '''72'''(9–10), 647–650 (1994), doi:10.1139/p94-083
</ref> and conducting medium.<ref name=BorUtkCond1994>
V.V. Borisov & A.B. Utkin, 
[http://www.nrcresearchpress.com/doi/abs/10.1139/p94-083 Focus wave modes in conducting media.]
''Canadian Journal of Physics'' '''72'''(9–10), 725–730 (1994), doi:10.1139/p94-083
</ref>

* 2000 Constructing a new class of relatively undistorted progressing waves.<ref name=BorKis2000>
V.V. Borisov & A.P. Kiselev
[http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S089396599900213X# A new class of relatively undistorted progressing waves.]
''Applied Mathematics Letters'' '''13'''(4), 83–86 (2000), doi:10.1016/S0893-9659(99)00213-X.
</ref>

* 2005 Description of several specific phenomena occurring in waves produced by a travelling source pulse with high-frequency filling.<ref name=BorReuUtk2005>
V.V. Borisov, N.M. Reutova, & A.B. Utkin, 
[http://iopscience.iop.org/0305-4470/38/10/012 Electromagnetic waves produced by a travelling current pulse with high-frequency filling.] 
''Journal of Physics A: Mathematical and General'', '''38'''(10), 2225–2240 (2005), doi:10.1088/0305-4470/38/10/012.</ref>
